title: Cobble Industry!
description: This modpack combines industrial mods such as create, oritech and mystical agriculture with cobblemon. It's still a work in progress! Collect cobblemon, and expand your factory!
body:
This modpack focuses on industrialization. Explore the world, collect pokemon, build, and expand your factory with mods like create, oritech and mystical agriculture! The world is for you to reshape. I combined cobblemon and the listed above mods into one, and am planning to add a lot of fun quests next update! If you seek a relaxing industrial experience with your favorite critters, this modpack is for you! I hope you'll enjoy it just as much as I am. It's still a giant WIP!

**Main mods of this modpack:**
Cobblemon
Create
Oritech
Mystical Agriculture
Terralith
Cobblemon: Mega showdown

Credits to all mod creators who make this possible. This modpack is meant for fun and mods make fun possible :heart:
